tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand colour (BrandPrimary). Filled buttons, links, GroupLabel text, row icons. Text-grade on surface and every surface-container in its theme.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (filled button label).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: HeroIcon disc, ATTENTION banners — a tonal brand fill, never text.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Neutral indigo for generic selected states (FilterChip). Never a parent colour: pink is not routed through secondary.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: The offline ConnectivityBanner and selected chips — fill only.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Emerald accent used as text for good status ("Up to date", "Synced at 15:05"). Text-grade on every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on a tertiary fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Tint of an event that belongs to neither parent.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Window behind every screen (also the cold-start window colour).

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Text on background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen and Scaffold surface; top bars.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on surface and every surface-container. 15.9:1 light / 13.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Neutral disc behind an event's member initial (FAM-5).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: supporting lines, descriptions, banner body, meta. AA on surface and containers.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest elevation container.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Low container; quiet cards.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: SectionGroup and INFO banner fill — one tonal container per run of rows.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Raised container: sheets, menus.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Highest container; text fields' fill.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed surface.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Bright surface.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar surface.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar text.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Snackbar action.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined PillChip border, the school-vacation line along a day's bottom edge, field borders. 3:1 as a control border.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Dividers between SectionRows (drawn at 40 % alpha).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Destructive text: sign out, unpair, a destructive dialog's confirm. Text, not a filled slab.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error container.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on error-container.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal scrim.

tokens.name: parent-pink
tokens.usage: Pink — slot 1 default preset, FILL-ONLY: event dots, identity borders, legend dots, the corner triangle of a contact window. Never text — under 4.5:1 on surface. Identifies a person, never a role.

tokens.name: parent-pink-text
tokens.usage: Pink — slot 1 default as a foreground: a parent's name or slot label on surface. AA in its theme.

tokens.name: parent-pink-chip
tokens.usage: Pink — slot 1 default solid chip with white text (month event chip, a label on the parent colour). White on it clears AA; white on the full hue does not.

tokens.name: parent-pink-wash
tokens.usage: Pink — slot 1 default custody wash over a day cell or a week column: the fill at 20 % (light) / 30 % (dark). Day number, holiday red and event titles hold AA on it.

tokens.name: parent-blue
tokens.usage: Blue — slot 2 default preset, FILL-ONLY: event dots, identity borders, legend dots, the corner triangle of a contact window. Never text — under 4.5:1 on surface. Identifies a person, never a role.

tokens.name: parent-blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue — slot 2 default as a foreground: a parent's name or slot label on surface. AA in its theme.

tokens.name: parent-blue-chip
tokens.usage: Blue — slot 2 default solid chip with white text (month event chip, a label on the parent colour). White on it clears AA; white on the full hue does not.

tokens.name: parent-blue-wash
tokens.usage: Blue — slot 2 default custody wash over a day cell or a week column: the fill at 20 % (light) / 30 % (dark). Day number, holiday red and event titles hold AA on it.

tokens.name: parent-purple
tokens.usage: Purple preset, FILL-ONLY: event dots, identity borders, legend dots, the corner triangle of a contact window. Never text — under 4.5:1 on surface. Identifies a person, never a role.

tokens.name: parent-purple-text
tokens.usage: Purple as a foreground: a parent's name or slot label on surface. AA in its theme.

tokens.name: parent-purple-chip
tokens.usage: Purple solid chip with white text (month event chip, a label on the parent colour). White on it clears AA; white on the full hue does not.

tokens.name: parent-purple-wash
tokens.usage: Purple custody wash over a day cell or a week column: the fill at 20 % (light) / 30 % (dark). Day number, holiday red and event titles hold AA on it.

tokens.name: parent-orange
tokens.usage: Deep orange preset, FILL-ONLY: event dots, identity borders, legend dots, the corner triangle of a contact window. Never text — under 4.5:1 on surface. Identifies a person, never a role.

tokens.name: parent-orange-text
tokens.usage: Deep orange as a foreground: a parent's name or slot label on surface. AA in its theme.

tokens.name: parent-orange-chip
tokens.usage: Deep orange solid chip with white text (month event chip, a label on the parent colour). White on it clears AA; white on the full hue does not.

tokens.name: parent-orange-wash
tokens.usage: Deep orange custody wash over a day cell or a week column: the fill at 20 % (light) / 30 % (dark). Day number, holiday red and event titles hold AA on it.

tokens.name: friend-teal
tokens.usage: The calendar friend (a guardian, grandparent, friend). A person, never a control; far from every parent hue. Text-grade in its theme. Teal 158°–188° is off the parents' colour wheel.

tokens.name: weekend
tokens.usage: Base layer of every Saturday/Sunday cell, borrowed days included. Custody, holiday and today are drawn OVER it, never instead of it.

tokens.name: holiday-red
tokens.usage: A public holiday's day number. AA on surface, weekend and every custody wash.

tokens.name: on-chip
tokens.usage: Label on a parent-*-chip fill.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: An invitation code (InviteCodeText, tabular figures, 6px tracking).

styles.name: body-medium-emphasized
styles.usage: The proposed time on a change request; a split's amount. bodyMedium one weight step up.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: PillChip label, offline banner; emphasized + uppercase for GroupLabel.

styles.name: label-medium-emphasized
styles.usage: GroupLabel (uppercase, primary). Emphasis is one weight step up, never a free fontWeight.

spacing.note: A 4 dp grid plus a 2 dp hairline (theme/Spacing.kt). dp = px here.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Gap inside a dense element (Spacing.XXS).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gap: banner title to body, GroupLabel side inset (Spacing.XS).

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and actions; chip vertical padding; GroupLabel to its group (Spacing.S).

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in a row or banner; chip horizontal padding (Spacing.M).

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Screen gutter; SectionRow, banner and StickyActionBar padding (Spacing.L).

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between groups on a screen; EmptyState side padding (Spacing.XL).

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Around an empty or first-run screen's content (Spacing.XXL).

radius.note: MaterialTheme.shapes plus CoPlanlyCorners (theme/Shape.kt) — no other corner.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: A dense calendar mark (CoPlanlyCorners.Mark).

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: A small tag; a month event chip (CoPlanlyCorners.Tag).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: shapes.extraSmall: small controls, a day cell's selection.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: shapes.small: text fields, menus, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: shapes.medium: SectionGroup, InlineBanner, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: shapes.large: dialogs, bottom sheets, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: shapes.extraLarge: hero surfaces, full-screen sheets.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: A chat bubble's round corners; 6px between bubbles of one run, 4px for the tail.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: CoPlanlyCorners.Pill: PillChip, HeroIcon disc, avatars.

iconSize.note: theme/IconSizes.kt. Icons do not scale with the font.

tokens.name: icon-inline
tokens.usage: A mark inside a line of text or a pill.

tokens.name: icon-small
tokens.usage: In a button, a chip, a banner or a status line.

tokens.name: icon-standard
tokens.usage: List rows, icon buttons, FABs.

tokens.name: icon-large
tokens.usage: The glyph a choice card leads with.

tokens.name: icon-hero
tokens.usage: On the 72px HeroIcon disc of an empty, error or first-run screen.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: StickyActionBar's 8 dp elevation over a form's content. Surfaces otherwise separate by tone, not by shadow.
